subject.title: refactor(transcripts): add SQLite storage backend to TranscriptsStore

question: Should meeting-capture transcripts follow the repository's one-way Doctor migration to a single SQLite authority, or should this module intentionally support a permanent optional dual backend?
rationale: The linked issue and root storage policy specify a canonical SQLite runtime, while this PR implements a materially different dual-backend ownership model.

options.title: Require one SQLite authority
options.body: Rework the PR around typed Kysely access, Doctor import and verification, and production caller adoption with no metadata or utterance runtime fallback.

options.title: Sponsor dual-backend support
options.body: Explicitly approve the alternate product direction and require ownership rules, compatibility documentation, divergence handling, and coverage for both backends.

options.title: Pause this migration
options.body: Close or defer the PR if the module is not important enough to justify the required Doctor and upgrade work.

recommendation.title: Require one SQLite authority
recommendation.body: Rework the PR around typed Kysely access, Doctor import and verification, and production caller adoption with no metadata or utterance runtime fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available routing candidate from the recent merged shared-state and transcript migration history.
